summary: Londian Wason New Energy Tech, Inc. is engaged in the research, development, and manufacture of copper-based materials. The company's products include lithium-ion battery copper foil, electronic circuit copper foil, and flexible copper-clad laminate. It was founded on September 30, 2022, and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
